intro: Lesson 7: The Farewell Pilgrimage. To understand the events of the Farewell Pilgrimage and why it completed the teaching of Hajj

passage.title: Qur'an, al-Ma'idah 5:3 (translation of the meaning)
paras: This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favour upon you and have approved for you Islam as religion.

questions.q: Explain why the Farewell Pilgrimage was important for Muslims.
questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ showed the rites of Hajj in full, gave his final sermon and 5:3 announced the religion was complete.
questions.model: Point: it completed Hajj and the religion. Evidence: 'Take your rites from me' (Muslim); 5:3 revealed at Arafah (Bukhari and Muslim). Explain: Muslims learned Hajj exactly, and Allah declared Islam complete. Link: months later the Prophet ﷺ died.

questions.q: On which day do pilgrims stand at Arafah?
Hajj map task on the pupil PDF: label Mina, Arafah and Muzdalifah, add the days and what happened, then in the portal response box: 'The Farewell Pilgrimage matters because ...' (one PEEL paragraph).
questions.a: Correct map and days; paragraph with 5:3 and 'take your rites from me'
questions.model: Teacher labels Arafah: '9 Dhul-Hijjah: standing and the sermon; 5:3 revealed.'

questions.a: The Prophet ﷺ hinted he might not meet them again and died about three months later.

questions.q: what does 'perfected your religion' (5:3) mean for adding new acts of worship?
questions.a: Islam is complete: nothing new is added to worship.

questions.q: 'Take your rites from me' refers to ...
Back to our ponder: what did the Prophet ﷺ make sure to tell them?
questions.a: The rites, and the core messages of his sermon.
